Name: A shocking demise
Desc: As an Arcfiend, stop at least six hearts using Jolt. It is not cumulative; you must do this within a single round. Jolt costs 200 energy, so you also need to sap at least 1200 (6 x 200) energy. You get this medal at the end of the round, rather than the moment you reach six hearts stopped, so that the OOC medal announcement doesn't expose your presence.

Name: Better to burn out, than fade away
Desc: Complete the Scientist objective and Research Director objective of escaping on the emergency shuttle while on fire with the chemical Silver Sulfadiazine in your system.

Name: Bill Masen
Desc: Complete the Botanist objective of having three mutated plants alive at the end of the round.

Name: Black and Blue
Desc: As in, your corpse is black and blue. Blue, because you're dead and aren't getting oxygen, and black, because you died with 400 seconds of Burning, at which point the tooltip for the status effects says you're "extremely on fire". Dying via the suicide command renders you ineligible for this medal.

Name: Block Stacker
Desc: Score 30,000 points on Robustris Pro.

Name: Brown Pants
Desc: The medal's icon illustrates it very well: as a Captain, you must successfully insert the authentication disk into the Nuclear Operatives' nuclear bomb. The "nuke ops" aren't going to let you do that without a fight, so if you want this medal, then follow the medal description and "show no fear in the face of battle"! You cannot obtain this medal by inserting the auth disk into a micronuke(or its defended variant), even though that bomb also accepts the disk. The admin-spawned "event nukes" don't work either. Only full-sized ones from the Nuclear Emergency mode count!

Name: Bury the Dead
Desc: Complete the Chaplain objective of having zero corpses on station at the end of the round.

Name: Call 1-800-CODER
Desc: runtime error: Cannot execute player.unlock_medal() (Cause Goonstation's code to return an error. This does not necessarily mean youвЂ™ll get an error message on your end. However, it does show up on the adminsвЂ™ log of runtimes/errors.)

Name: Contributor
Desc: You cannot get this medal on your own. An admin has to give it to you. This medal is typically bestowed on people who have made major contributions to the game, such as by fixing dozens of bugs or doing lots of re-sprites. As the Goonhub description puts it, thanks <3

Name: Cream of the Crop
Desc: As a Wrestler complete all of your objectives.

Name: Damned
Desc: Die via the suicide command; just enter suicide in the command bar/text parser at the bottom of your screen. The command offers a lot of different ways to die depending on what objects you're holding, what devices you're next to, and whether you're a human, cyborg, etc., and they all make you eligible for the medal, so just pick one you like. Just go through with it; if you use the command but cancel at the prompt, you won't get the medal, so merely entering the command isn't enough.

Name: Dangerous Game
Desc: As a hunter collect enough a high enough value of skulls to complete your objective.

Name: Dead or alive, you're coming with me
Desc: Complete the Security Officer objective or Head of Security objective of having an antagonist in handcuffs on the escape shuttle at the end of the round.

Name: Dracula Jr.
Desc: As a Vampire accumulate enough blood to complete the"Accumulate at least [number] units of blood in total" objective.

Name: DUI
Desc: Driving under the influence while on a MULEBot, specifically. Run someone over with a MULEBot while riding on it and while you have some ethanol in your system. One unit, ten, hundred, doesn't matter how much. This can hurt quite a lot, so if you're not an antagonist, don't do this without a good reason. (If you are an antag, go right ahead.)

Name: Expendable
Desc: Die as a Revolutionary, specifically a regular one, not a Head Revolutionary. If you died via the suicide verb, it doesn't count towards this medal, but otherwise, it doesn't matter how you go, comrade.

Name: Fell down the stairs
Desc: Die while handcuffed. Again, it doesn't matter how you die, so long as you didn't use the suicide command for it (which is somewhat of a shame since cuffs have a unique suicide.) Having shackles doesn't count for this, but zipties/plastic cuffs and silver handcuffs do, as do regular handcuffs, obviously. Since the code counts them as handcuffs, being duct-taped also works.

Name: Fish
Desc: Late join into an ongoing round for the first time.

Name: For Your Ohm Good
Desc: Get vaporized by walking into an extremely high-power power transmission laser. The laser needs somewhere in the range of at least 200 Megawatts to gib you.

Name: Fun Times
Desc: Participate in one of the contests on the forums. These used to be monthly, but now they're enacted on admin discretion. Contests usually last a few weeks, and the admins take care to announce them, so as long as you check back on the forums from time to time, you won't miss out.

Name: Glass Ceiling
Desc: Complete the Staff Assistant objective of having a non-assistant ID assigned to you at the end of the round. This ranges from easy to impossible depending on the presence of the Head of Personnel.

Name: Good Feasting
Desc: As a werewolf, reach your objective number of victims fed on.

Name: Gore Fest
Desc: Get gibbed. If you're unfamiliar with that term, it means your body basically explodes into a mess of body parts and assorted remains, often due to an explosion. It doesn't necessary have to be human remains; getting gibbed as a cyborg, critter, etc. counts. Unlike many other death-related medals, this one doesn't care if you used the suicide command.

Name: Guardin' Gnome
Desc: Complete the Staff Assistant objective of ensuring Gnome Chompski is on the emergency shuttle OR escape on the emergency shuttle as any role with Gnome Chompski in your inventory. Gnome Chompski can be found in hidden locations on several maps. Be careful not to lose sight of him! He teleports when he is out of sight.

Name: High Five!
Desc: While there is indeed a high-five emote, you don't earn it via that. Instead, you need to shock someone with stun gloves.

Name: HIGH VOLTAGE
Desc: Get electrocuted in some way; you don't necessarily have to die because of it. The game actually offers quite a few ways to earn this: getting shocked by a wire, an APC, or a door all work as you'd expect, but so does walking into an active singularity engine's containment field, getting zapped by a GuardBuddy with an Elektro-Arc tool module, and getting hit by any of the various Adventure Zone enemies that attack with electricity.

Name: honk HONK mother FU-
Desc: Complete the Staff Assistant objective of wearing at least one piece of Clown clothing at the end of the round.

Name: HUMANOID MUST NOT ESCAPE
Desc: Die on the escape shuttle. Doesn't matter how, so long as it wasn't through the suicide command. Since the shuttle is so tightly packed, it's a frequent target for antagonists on a murder spree, so you might earn this medal without even trying to.

Name: I don't give a shit
Desc: Complete the Staff Assistant objective of having your butt by any means at the end of the round. A safe bet for having your butt removed is usually visiting Robotics though they may want it for reasons.

Name: I helped!
Desc: End a round as a Security Assistant.

Name: I'm In
Desc: Successfully gain superuser access on a TermOS terminal via the su command. The AI, Captain, Cyborgs, Head of Security, and Research Director all spawn with superuser access, and it's possible to spoof it via certain commands.

Name: It's frickin' freezing in here, Mr. Bigglesworth
Desc: Complete the Medical Doctor objective and Medical Director objective of having the Medical Objects#Cryogenic Healing Pod on and under 225K at the end of the round.

Name: It's just a flesh wound!
Desc: Make it to Central Command (aka, CentCom) with a bullet (or more) embedded in you. The precise type doesn't matter, and you can have multiple bullets lodged in you. Shrapnel doesn't count.

Name: It's not 'Door to Heaven'
Desc: Complete the Engineer objective of having at least two functional command teleporters

Name: Jimi Heselden
Desc: Ride a segway into outer space/ the sea. A reference to Jimi Heselden, an executive (but not founder or inventor) of Segway, Inc. who famously ran off a cliff while on a Segway. He died as a result of that, but you don't actually need to die to earn this medal, just enter space/sea.

Name: Law 1: Don't be an asshat
Desc: Asimov's laws were definitely behind, because ol' Isaac did not foresee a robot wearing someone's ass as a hat. As the medal image shows, you need to put a butt on the AI's core unit, which, by default, spawns in the AI Chamber.

Name: Life, uh... finds a way
Desc: Complete the Geneticist objective and Medical Director objective of having at least 5 people scanned in the Clone Console. Cloning people does remove them from the list of people scanned, so it would be in good practice to scan anyone that is cloned.

Name: Licensed Archaeologist
Desc: Complete the Scientist or Research Director objective of activating 10 artifacts in a single shift.

Name: Manhattan Project
Desc: Successfully destroy the station with a nuclear detonation as a Nuclear Operative

Name: Man with a Scan
Desc: Complete the Engineer objective of having 10 or more objects scanned in the ruckingeur kit.

Name: Many names, many faces
Desc: As a Changeling, complete the Changeling objective"Absorb the DNA of at least [absorb_count] more crew members in addition to the one you started with, and escape on the shuttle alive."

Name: Meth is a hell of a drug
Desc: Complete the Scientist objective and Research Director objective of ending the round with methamphetamine in your system.

Name: Misclick
Desc: Pry up a floor tile from some flooring using a crowbar; this is specifically for intact flooring, so you can't get this by removing burnt or broken tiles. The joke is that people fighting with crowbars often miss and target the floor instead of their opponent, accidentally prying floor tiles instead of the other person's face.

Name: MISSION COMPLETE
Desc: As an Antagonist complete your objectives.

Name: Monkey Duty
Desc: Complete the "Keep Monsieur Stirstir brigged but also make sure that he comes to absolutely no harm" Security Officer, Security Assistant, and Head of Security objective. This is quite difficult to do as monkeys tend to use tables to flip into walls and other objects. It would be best to check on Stirstir regularly and make sure they aren't hurt and haven't been taken or murdered by a Traitor.

Name: Mostly Armless
Desc: When the round ends, you need to be at Central Command/CentCom with both your arms missing. You need to be playing a human to earn this one; while you can wind up a cyborg without any arms at round-end, it won't get you this medal.

Name: Neither fashionable noir stylish
Desc: Complete the Detective objective of wearing your coat, hat, and uniform at the end of the round.

Name: Noah's Shuttle
Desc: Have 7 station pets on the shuttle when it arrives at Central Command. Station pets include pretty much every Critter(i.e. no monkeys) that has a name, e.g. Heisenbee, Sylvester, Jones the Cat, "jons the catte", the Pool space seals--basically, if the end of round stats mentions they escaped on the shuttle at the end, it counts towards this medal. Pets from Pet Person do not count for this.

Name: On My Own Two (Space) Legs
Desc: Complete the in-game tutorial, meaning the one you enter by clicking the Play Tutorial button in the server's lobby. More specifically, you need to kill the NPC clown at the end.

Name: OW! MY BALLS!
Desc: Some places just can't take the pain. Get groin-punched by Senator Death Badman as a result of ingesting mimicillium.

Name: Party Hard
Desc: Die next to a tube of (deployed) neon lining or with a glowstick(any kind) in your inventory while drunk. Any level of drunkenness is fine.

Name: Patchwork
Desc: Complete the Medical Doctor objective and Medical Director objective of having used ten or more medical patches on injured people in a single round. A person is only counted as injured if their health is below 90%. Patches applied to yourself don't count.

Name: Primordial
Desc: Complete the Staff Assistant objective of escaping on the escape shuttle as a monkey. This can easily be achieved by going to Genetics and requesting they turn you into a one.

Name: Primum non nocere
Desc: Complete the Medical Doctor objective and Medical Director objective of not preforming a single violent act the entire round. This means that you cannot punch, use a weapon, or shoot anyone even if it is in self defense. You can still disarm and grab people without breaking your oath.

Name: Professional Thief
Desc: As Spy Thief, complete your " Steal at least X items in total via your uplink." objective.

Name: Progenitor
Desc: Complete the Roboticist Doctor objective and Medical Director objective of having at least three living Cyborgs at the end of the round.

Name: Puerile humour
Desc: Complete the Roboticist objective and Medical Director objective of having at least five buttbots on station at the end of the round. Getting you hands on butts should be easy considering that some Staff Assistants will sometimes come to you for this.

Name: Quit Cloning Around
Desc: Acquire more than 7 cloner defects, which means getting cloned multiple times. "Diminishing reruns" indeed...

Name: Red Hood
Desc: There are two ways to earn this. The first is to get your head cut off through surgery. Getting decapitated via a katana or a suicide doesn't count. The second is to get your face disfigured due to mixing fluorosulfuric acid without a proper mask on or getting splashed with any of the various acids or grog.

Name: Reefer Madness
Desc: Complete the Botanist objective of having no Cannabis plants, seeds, or products inside botany at the end of the round. This does in fact have the obvious loop hole that you can simply grow and store your cannabis elsewhere on station or just move it all at the end of the round.

Name: Reserved Parking
Desc: Have the emergency shuttle land on you. You can't be in a pod, locker, or anything else that might protect you, meaning that you'll get gibbed by being squished.

Name: Shit Fest
Desc: Blow yourself up with Empowered High-Pressure Intestines.

Name: Shit for brains
Desc: Complete the Staff Assistant objective of having your own butt on your head when you escape on the shuttle. A safe bet for having your butt removed is usually visiting Robotics though they may want it for reasons.

Name: Silent Running
Desc: Complete the Roboticist objective and Medical Director objective of having at least five Medibots on station at the end of the round. This does include the Medibot named " Head Surgeon" that sometimes can be seen in Medbay.

Name: Slow Burn
Desc: Complete the Chief Engineer and Engineer objective of having all furnaces on station running. Furnaces can be found in Engineering and sometimes the Sauna depending on the map.

Name: Smooth Operator
Desc: Complete the Medical Doctor objective and Medical Director objective of being completely unharmed when the escape shuttle leaves for Central Command.

Name: Spotless
Desc: Complete the one of the Janitor objectives of keeping the Bar, Brig, or Medbay completely clean with no blood, gibs, oil, or other messes staining the floor at the end of the round.

Name: Suitable? How about the Oubliette?!
Desc: Stuff someone down a brig chute.

Name: Tax Haven
Desc: Complete the Quartermaster objective of accumulating a budget of 100K credits. This ranges from easy to difficult depending of how savvy you and your fellow QMs are with purchases and exports, how often you need to make purchases, and randomly stumbling upon high value items such as starstone or stamped gold bullion

Name: Territorial Defender

Name: The mail always goes through

This can be gotten by asking Cargo Bay if they have any mail/postmaster clothes, bugging a Mail Courier for their clothes, or finding it elsewhere.

Name: The Syndicate Connection

Name: Through the fire and flames
Desc: We carry on! While the name references the hit DragonForce song, getting this medal is much more mundane than its name or image might suggest. While on fire, you need to stop, drop, and roll by pressing the RESIST button on your HUD (Hotkey: Z for Goon WASD, C for /tg/style WASD). Clicking on the Burning status effect icon will attempt to make you do this automatically.

Name: Tipsy

Name: To the stars

Name: Too Cool
Desc: Win one of the contests that occur on the forums. There used to be a contest every month, but now they're held basically whenever the admins feel like it. They usually announce these contests, and the window to submit entries usually lasts at least a week or more, so you don't have to worry about missing out if you check on the forums every so often.
